title: Monthly Calls Per Doctor
description: Cycle/date-range call count by territory and doctor, modeled after the legacy rptMonthlyCallsPerDoctor report.

source.sql: select top 2000 ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))) as territory_id, nullif(ltrim(rtrim(concat(isnull(d.LAST_NAME, ''), ', ', isnull(d.FIRST_NAME, '')))), ',') as doctor_name, ltrim(rtrim(cast(d.SPECIALTY_CODE as varchar(128)))) as specialty, isnull(ltrim(rtrim(cast(dc.FREQUENCY as varchar(128)))), '***') as frequency, isnull(ltrim(rtrim(cast(dc.CLASS_CODE as varchar(128)))), '***') as class_code, count_big(*) as calls from [dbo].[ITINERARY] i left join [dbo].[DOCTOR] d on i.MD_ID = d.MD_ID left join [dbo].[DOCTOR_CLINIC] dc on i.MD_ID = dc.MD_ID and i.TERRITORY_ID = dc.TERRITORY_ID where try_convert(date, i.VISIT_DATE) >= @startDate and try_convert(date, i.VISIT_DATE) <= @endDate {{territoryPredicate:i.TERRITORY_ID}} group by ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))), nullif(ltrim(rtrim(concat(isnull(d.LAST_NAME, ''), ', ', isnull(d.FIRST_NAME, '')))), ','), ltrim(rtrim(cast(d.SPECIALTY_CODE as varchar(128)))), isnull(ltrim(rtrim(cast(dc.FREQUENCY as varchar(128)))), '***'), isnull(ltrim(rtrim(cast(dc.CLASS_CODE as varchar(128)))), '***') order by territory_id, doctor_name
